title: JCT Just Did a 6X in a Day: Here's What's Next
description:
$JCT ran 6X in a single day with no news behind it, and the setup on the futures side is what could decide whether this pump keeps going. My community got into it back in June and caught both of its pumps, 17X off the February low.

I break down what Janction actually is: the $JASMY-incubated GPU marketplace where GPU owners pool their cards and AI and 3D teams rent the compute. Then the strange part. Is it a Layer 2 or a Layer 1? Its own docs and its own bio disagree, and its tech stack is described three different ways.

Then the numbers: roughly $1.5 billion traded on Binance perps against $321 million on spot, the short squeeze setup, what is actually live (and why neither product takes JCT yet), what the project has never made public, and the unlocks that start November 10 with 77% of the supply still locked.

Finally, how it is priced against its own parent and the other AI compute coins, and what would make it real.

#crypto #jct #janction #jasmy #aicrypto
